notes: The report (SitRep N°099, reporting date 21 August 2026, published 22 August 2026) gives 83 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, but only as provincial and health-zone aggregates: Ituri 62, Nord-Kivu 18, Haut-Uélé 3. Health-zone counts are 57 of 151 affected. The 'contacts à suivre' figure of 23,492 is a daily follow-up denominator (19,829 seen), not stated as a cumulative count of contacts currently under follow-up, so it was left null. The report gives no cumulative suspected-case total, so suspected_cases is null. The 345 validated suspected cases are new alerts for the day only.
